description: EagleGate behind the SDLS frame layer, set up for NOS3 telemetry. The link section mirrors NOS3's Crypto_SC_Init (components/cryptolib/src/core/crypto_config.c): check the field lengths against a captured frame (monitor mode) before enforcing. Packet rules can match link.vcid, link.spi and link.protection.

rules.description: Command-type packets never belong on the telemetry downlink
EXAMPLE (disabled): refuse telemetry that came in clear-mode frames (NOS3 sends on the clear VC 1 until TO_SET_VCID_CC switches it)
EXAMPLE (disabled): file transfer (CFDP, APID 0x7FD) only from authenticated frames; until the Phase 2 crypto backend checks MACs, auth_unverified is the best there is
Every telemetry packet that passed the frame checks; narrow this to the mission's APIDs
